rules.title: Distinct geographic roles
rules.statement: Country roles remain separate fields and may hold different values.

rules.title: Multiple Member States
rules.statement: More than one Member-State module may be required for one case.

rules.title: Local context affects facts, not hierarchy
rules.statement: Applicant-country evidence may alter factual support and therefore the core conclusion, but may not redefine source hierarchy or issue the overall conclusion.

rules.title: Exact deadline dependency
rules.statement: Exact deadline calculation requires an identified trigger and supported rule.

rules.title: Authority recommendation dependency
rules.statement: Escalation requires an authority with the relevant jurisdiction and competence.

rules.title: Coverage state and negative conclusion
rules.statement: Not checked, blocked, missing or unsupported work cannot be rendered as no problem.

rules.title: Source freshness and current-law support
rules.statement: Stale source state blocks unqualified current-law support.

rules.title: National rule provenance
rules.statement: National declarative rules require a source link and version scope.

rules.title: Unsupported operator behavior
rules.statement: Unsupported national-rule operators remain explicit and are not approximated.

rules.title: Purpose-specific outbound eligibility
rules.statement: Outbound eligibility is purpose-specific.

rules.title: Recipient-bound approval
rules.statement: A recipient change invalidates the prior bound approval.

rules.title: Case data and distributable assets
rules.statement: Private/case-specific information does not become reusable module content.

rules.title: Optional local context gap
rules.statement: Absence of optional local context creates only the affected completeness gap.

rules.title: Principle-source dependency
rules.statement: Material use of a legal principle requires explicit source support.

rules.title: Charter scope dependency
rules.statement: Charter applicability is assessed only within the scope of EU law.

rules.title: Proof restriction provenance
rules.statement: Closed-list or proof restrictions require source support and must be assessed against any freedom-of-proof rule.

rules.title: Attack-angle support
rules.statement: A supported compliance attack angle requires both legal source support and sufficient evidence.

rules.title: Representation and exact wording
rules.statement: Identity/version-verified notes support source identity and modelling but not exact quotations or pinpoints.

rules.title: Typed event duration
rules.statement: A calculated duration must remain linked to the typed dated event context from which it was derived.

rules.title: Frontier-worker topology
rules.statement: Frontier-worker analysis preserves residence and work states as separate legal roles and may require multiple Member-State modules.

rules.title: Article 41 Member-State boundary
rules.statement: Distinguish Charter Article 41 direct addressees from general EU-law rights of defence/good-administration principles applicable to Member-State action.

rules.title: Soft-law binding force
rules.statement: Non-binding guidance/recommendations may carry interpretive weight without being recoded as binding law.

rules.title: Scoped dependency gap
rules.statement: Missing dependencies create explicit scoped gaps connected to the dependent claim.

rules.title: Epistemic state separation
rules.statement: Knowledge/conflict state is recorded independently from substantive proposition value.

rules.title: Strategy prerequisites
rules.statement: Strategic priority is assessed only after prerequisites, evidentiary value, cost and systemic value remain separately represented.
